Three days of barrel racing, bull riding, drag, dancing, and the friendliest boots-and-buckles crowd in the region, all in Oklahoma City the weekend of August 7 to 9. It is an easy road trip from Tulsa and worth every mile. Best-time tip for the shy ones: go for the Saturday daytime events when the grandstand is relaxed and folks love to explain what is happening, then stay for the evening social where the real community magic happens.

events.name: HHHH First Friday: PFLAG Tulsa Fundraiser
events.description: Homo Hotel Happy Hour takes over the Courtyard Downtown, and this month every dollar raised goes to PFLAG Tulsa. Come for the hotel-bar glamour, stay because your cover charge keeps parents showing up for their queer kids.
events.website_description: August's Homo Hotel Happy Hour lands at the Courtyard Downtown on Boston Ave, 6 to 8 p.m., and it is a fundraiser for PFLAG Tulsa, the folks who have been showing up for 2SLGBTQIA+ Tulsans and their families every month for years. First Fridays at HHHH are the easiest social on the calendar: a hotel bar full of friendly faces, no dress code, no agenda, come alone and you will not stay alone long. This one comes with a bonus: the money goes somewhere that matters.
